scripts/installer_support.ps1

PowerShell · Tier B

Share verified legal acceptance and command logging with the Windows installer.

Usage

Dot-source from the Windows Gateway installer before provisioning.

Inputs

Checkout root, document review/version flags, interactive answers and Verbose.

Side effects

Reads and hashes packaged terms, writes a private per-invocation receipt, and executes installer commands with captured output unless verbose mode is requested.

Cleanup

Restores console input handling; removes successful logs and retains failed logs. Receipts do not authorize future invocations or change runtime EULA consent.
